title: Mystic Lotus Portal Guardian
description: A skeletal figure with purple hair in a maroon suit runs up ancient stone temple stairs while holding a peace sign. A large glowing blue and purple lotus portal floats in the center of the temple facade, surrounded by floating bubbles containing small figures. The scene is set in a fantastical jungle with a massive tree growing from the temple top under a swirling purple cosmic sky with light beams.
prompt: A skeletal figure with long purple hair wearing a maroon suit and green shoes runs dynamically up the stairs of an ancient stone temple, making a peace sign with one hand. A large luminous blue and purple lotus energy portal glows in the center of the temple wall. The temple has colorful stained glass windows with sun and lotus motifs. A massive ancient tree with hanging purple flowers grows from the top of the temple. The background shows a swirling purple cosmic sky with light beams breaking through, surrounded by lush jungle foliage. Translucent bubbles containing small figures float around the scene. Lava flows from cracked stones in the foreground.
